name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The candidate includes redundant hard Existence clauses that repeat what the precedence chain already forces. Remove the following clauses: - Existence(has_matching_key) (R1) – it is implied by the later hard goals and the Precedence chain. - Existence(target_door_open) (R3) – implied by the later steps via Precedence(target_door_open, target_room_entered) and Existence(target_picked_up). - Existence(target_room_entered) (R5) – implied by Existence(target_picked_up) and the Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up). Keeping only the final hard goal Existence(target_picked_up) together with the four hard Precedence clauses (key_found→has_matching_key, has_matching_key→target_door_open, target_door_open→target_room_entered, target_room_entered→target_picked_up) correctly captures the task without unnecessary goals.

texts: The key must be seen before it is picked up.
The locked door can be opened only after the matching key has been picked up.
The target room can be entered only after the locked door is open.
The target ball can be picked up only after the target room has been entered.
Eventually pick up the target ball.
